dedupe_keys.name: portal of watercourses and wetlands of the czech republic aopk cr

description: The Portal of watercourses and wetlands of the Nature Conservation Agency of the Czech Republic gives information and data from the mapping of selected watercourses, migration barriers and important wetlands, produced by several agency projects including the watercourse passportisation project. It has an interactive map of watercourse sections, barriers, outlets, beaver dams, wetlands and proposed measures; downloadable databases of wetlands, watercourse sections, barriers and outlets with notes on how the data was collected; citizen data collection; short videos on typical measures; methodological support; and examples of good practice and funding for measures. Articles on the site report that the agency's experts walked almost 24,000 km of streams and small rivers over two years, more than a quarter of the national network, recording outlets, transverse barriers, unsuitable bank reinforcement, culverted channels and other problems. Access is free; no licence is stated on the page read, and data terms are given in the agency's data provision service. Caveats: the site is in Czech and the mapping covers selected watercourses, not the whole network. Coverage is the Czech Republic. It supports climate adaptation and hazard exposure analysis, such as river restoration and natural water retention planning around culverts, weirs and road crossings; the related record is the AOPK data provision service.
